title: Demos
subtitle: Live demonstrations running on the Xeon server. Pick one.

demos.name: Agent Orchestrator
demos.blurb: Create persistent agents with tools, budgets, and schedules; decompose a prompt into a plan you approve; watch a validated team execute it live.

demos.name: Capacity Planner
demos.blurb: Benchmark this server for agent workloads: ramp fixed tiles of real agent traces until an SLO breaks, see which profile and resource gated, and compare runs over time.

demos.name: Semantic Router
demos.blurb: Classifies each query by difficulty and routes it to the cheapest sufficient model tier — on-box for easy work, escalating off-box only when needed.

demos.name: Voice Assistant
demos.blurb: Talk to the server from a browser tab. Speech recognition, Qwen3-30B reasoning and speech synthesis all run on Xeon CPU with no GPU — and it starts speaking after the first phrase rather than waiting for the whole answer.
